basic.name: Shuriken
basic.description:
Throw 3 Shuriken in a spread pattern, each dealing 65~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit.

Stores up to 3 charges. Shuriken's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

basic.name: Deflect
basic.description:
Channel for 1.25 seconds, becoming Protected and blocking damage. Any damage blocked while channeling causes Genji to throw a Kunai toward the nearest enemy, prioritizing Heroes and dealing 55~~0.04~~ damage.

Total Damage Deflected: 0

basic.name: Swift Strike
basic.description: Dash forward, dealing 190~~0.04~~ damage to all enemies in a line. Enemy Heroes that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit with Swift Strike cause the cooldown and mana cost to be refunded.

basic.name: Dragonblade
basic.description: Lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Dragonblade
heroic.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: X-Strike
heroic.description: Perform two slashes dealing 145~~0.04~~ damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in their area.

heroic.name: Dragonblade
heroic.description: Lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240~~0.04~~ damage.

trait.name: Cyber Agility
trait.description: Activate to jump to the target area.

activable.name: Dragon Claw
activable.description: Deal 190~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby enemies.

level1.name: Swift as the Wind
level1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Swift Strike increases Genji's Movement Speed by 40% for 3 seconds.

level1.name: Agile Dismount
level1.description: While mounted the range of Cyber Agility is increased by 70%, its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds, and it Slows enemy Heroes in its landing area by 25% for 2 seconds.

level1.name: Pathfinder
level1.description:
Jumping over terrain with Cyber Agility increases Movement Speed by 30%, and grants Stealth, for 6 seconds.

Passive: Genji's Heroic Ability heals him for 10% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes, increasing up to 30% the lower Genji's Health is.

level4.name: Shuriken Mastery
level4.description:
Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Shuriken.

Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Shuriken damage is increased by 25.

Reward: After hitting 60 Heroes, Cyber Agility now refunds 3 charges of Shuriken.

level4.name: Strike At The Heart
level4.description: Enemies hit by the end of Swift Strike take an additional 142~~0.04~~ damage after 1 second.

level4.name: Dragon Claw
level4.description: After Genji blocks 330~~0.04~~ damage with Deflect, activate to release a Dragon Claw, dealing 190~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby enemies.

level7.name: Augmented Guard
level7.description: When Deflect ends, Genji gains a Shield equal to 100% of the damage blocked for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Perfect Defense
level7.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 12.5 seconds.

level7.name: Cyber Shield
level7.description:
Using Cyber Agility grants 40 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

Passive: Genji dodges 1 Heroic Basic Attack every 5 seconds.

level10.name: Dragonblade
level10.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240~~0.04~~ damage.

level10.name: X-Strike
level10.description: Perform two slashes dealing 145~~0.04~~ damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in their area.

level13.name: Shingan
level13.description: Hitting an enemy with all 3 Shuriken deals 100~~0.04~~ bonus damage. Deals 40% less damage to Structures.

level13.name: Flow Like Water
level13.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Swift Strike reduces its cooldown by 4 seconds.

level13.name: Way Of The Shimada
level13.description: Increase Genji's Basic Attack range by 1. Each time Genji hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack, increase his Basic Attack damage by 1% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 15%.

level16.name: Reflect
level16.description: Deflect also deals an additional 33% of the damage blocked.

level16.name: Final Cut
level16.description: After 1 second, Swift Strike deals an additional 115~~0.04~~ damage to all enemies in the area.

level16.name: Steady Blade
level16.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Swift Strike increases the damage of the next Swift Strike by 30%. This bonus stacks up to 3 times.

level20.name: The Dragon Becomes Me
level20.description: Each time Dragonblade hits an enemy Hero, the duration of Dragonblade is increased by 0.5 seconds. If a Hero is killed within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Dragonblade, Swift Strike's cooldown is reset.

level20.name: Living Weapon
level20.description: Each enemy Hero hit by X-Strike reduces its cooldown by 12.5 seconds.

level20.name: Sharpened Stars
level20.description: Shuriken now pierce all enemies hit. Swift Strike's refund grants 1 charge of Shuriken.

level20.name: Zanshin
level20.description:
Quest: Block 6500 damage with Deflect, including damage blocked so far.

Reward: Deflect hits all nearby enemy Heroes.
